left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Women over age  [AND] 18 with a core biopsy proven borderline  [OR] or high-risk breast lesion that requires further excision for management based on the surgeon's assessment
  -  Informed consent must be obtained

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Women  [AND] who are considered high-risk based on a greater than 25% lifetime risk of breast cancer as per the IBIS (International Breast Cancer Intervention Study) Breast Cancer Risk Evaluation Tool
  -  Pathology that is felt to be discordant with imaging
  -  Extensive calcifications  [OR] extending more than 20 mm and/or masses greater than 30 mm
  -  The following lesions will be excluded based on their increased risk of upstaging; lesions (other than fibroadenomas, [OR]  phyllodes  [OR] and papillomas) that are associated with a palpable mass, [OR]  ADH  [AND] (atypical ductal hyperplasia) with high-risk features (ADH  [AND] with zonal necrosis, significant cytological atypia  [OR] or more than 2 foci), LCIS  [AND] (lobular carcinoma in situ) with high-risk features  [OR] (associated with ADH, [OR]  pleomorphic LCIS, [OR]  zonal necrosis  [OR] and > 4 foci) or discordant with imaging, [OR]  papilloma  [OR] with atypia, and spindle cell lesion (especially if there is atypia)

right.raw_text:
-  Lesions that are suspicious for borderline  [OR] or malignant Phyllodes, [OR]  DCIS (ductal carcinoma in situ), invasive mammary carcinoma, [OR]  or encapsulated papillary carcinoma
  -  Any lesion that either the radiologist, pathologist  [OR] or surgeon feels is not amenable to VAPE  [OR] or surgical excision
